depth_convention: Registered RGB optical-axis Z in metres; uint16/5000, zero invalid. No extra depth correction. Predicted local_points[...,2] already includes learned metric factor.
resampling: Predicted axial Z float32 574x434 ->640x480 PIL BILINEAR, no crop; GT never interpolated.
scale_arms: same Z times previously frozen trajectory Sim3 scale; no depth-derived fitting
pixel_policy: All GT>0 pixels included. Any nonfinite/nonpositive prediction at valid GT invalidates full frame scores. No confidence mask, depth clipping, edge erosion or threshold search.
frame_policy: All18 expected RGB frames retained. Existing20ms depth gate unchanged; board ordinal5 is missing. Full6/18-frame scores null if any frame unavailable; available-frame diagnostics explicitly labelled.
scope: Read-only depth diagnostics on retained outputs, not a new model candidate. Different-time RGB/depth <=20ms can still contain motion mismatch. GT has missing pixels; no complete-surface truth, geometry/task acceptance or SOTA.
